item.description:
Backstory - World History

← Back to Quest Lines | Index | Next: Characters →

📜 General Timeline

Pre-Collapse Era (2020-2030) 

2020-2025: Era of Instability
├── Global pandemic (COVID-19 and variants)
├── Escalating geopolitical conflicts
├── Energy and resource crises
└── Tech corporations gain immense power

2025-2029: The Corporate Age
├── Nexus Corporation becomes a mega-conglomerate
├── Project Prometheus initiates (classified)
├── Governments weaken, corporations rise
└── Neo-Asia Industrial Corridor develops rapidly

2030: The Final Year
├── Q1: Signs of systemic instability
├── Q2: First major Nexus data leak
├── Q3: Widespread protests and civil unrest
├── Q4: Harbingers of The Collapse

💥 The Collapse (2031)

The Causes - Triangle of Disaster 

            [CYBERATTACK]
               /    \
              /      \
             /   💀   \
            /  PERFECT \
           /   STORM   \
          /____________\
   [PANDEMIC]     [RESOURCE WAR]

1. The Cyberattack (January 2031)

  • Hacker groups simultaneously attack global infrastructure
  • Power grids, banking, and transport systems paralyzed
  • Origin: Unknown (Did the Tech Syndicate know?)

2. The Second Pandemic (February-March 2031)

  • New virus outbreak: “Crimson Flu”
  • Mortality rate: 15-20%
  • Origin: Lab leak? (Project Prometheus connection?)

3. The Resource War (March-April 2031)

  • Food and fuel shortages
  • Conflicts between nations over remaining resources
  • Militaries fracture into warlord factions

Detailed Event Chain

Date Event Consequence
Jan 15 Global blackout 72-hour global power loss
Jan 20 Bank system crash Economic collapse
Feb 1 Crimson Flu appears Hospitals overwhelmed
Feb 14 Quarantine fails Virus spreads globally
Mar 1 Food riots Widespread violence
Mar 15 Military splinters Army factions form
Apr 1 Government falls State dissolution
Apr 15 The Collapse complete The old world ends

🧪 The Outbreak - Project Prometheus Secrets

What is Project Prometheus? 

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│          PROJECT PROMETHEUS                  │
│     "Enhancement Through Integration"        │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Goal: Create the perfect human              │
│ Method: Combine AI + Human biology          │
│ Result: Subjects lost control               │
│ Consequence: The Outbreak                   │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────┘

Project Phases:

  1. Phase 1 (2026-2027): Neural interface testing
  2. Phase 2 (2028): First human trials (volunteers)
  3. Phase 3 (2029): Forced trials (prisoners)
  4. Phase 4 (2030): “Enhancement” subjects deployed
  5. Phase 5 (Jan 2031): CONTAINMENT FAILURE

The Subjects

Subject Characteristics:

  • Enhanced strength and reflexes
  • Reduced pain response
  • Increased aggression
  • Diminished humanity
  • Connection to central AI (broken during Collapse)

Current Status: Subjects are now AI Bosses in the game

  • “Reactor Guardian” = Subject 7 (former worker)
  • “The Scientist” = Dr. Volkov (project creator)
  • “The Warden” = Security Chief Marcus (Labs guard)

🏚️ The Exclusion Zones (2031-2036)

Formation of Quarantine Zones

Phase 1: Chaos (2031-2032)

  • Survivors seek shelter
  • Contamination zones expand
  • Old military remnants establish checkpoints

Phase 2: Stabilization (2033-2034)

  • Factions form and consolidate power
  • Trade routes established
  • Exclusion Zones officially designated

Phase 3: Extraction Economy (2035-2036)

  • Contractors (Players) appear
  • Black market develops
  • The Game begins at this point in time

Neo-Asia Exclusion Zone

Location: Fictional region, inspired by:

  • Abandoned Chinese ghost cities
  • Korean DMZ aesthetic
  • Japanese industrial zones
  • Southeast Asian urban sprawl

Characteristics:

Area: ~5000 km²
Pre-Collapse Population: 3 million
Post-Collapse Population: ~50,000 (survivors, scavengers)
Status: Partially contaminated
Control: Contested (factions fighting for dominance)

🏭 Regional History

Industrial Decay - “Sector 7”

Pre-Collapse:

  • Largest industrial zone in the region
  • 50,000 workers
  • Power plants, chemical processing, electronics manufacturing
  • Nexus Corp secret facility (The Labs)

During The Collapse:

Timeline:
Day 1: Power loss, workers trapped inside
Day 3: Radiation leak from reactor
Day 7: Military seals perimeter
Day 14: Last known survivor transmission
Day 30: Silence

Present Day:

  • AI threats (enhanced subjects + automated machines)
  • Radiation pockets
  • Valuable salvage (industrial materials)
  • Hidden Nexus secrets waiting to be uncovered

Urban Ruins - “District 14”

Pre-Collapse:

  • Commercial and residential hub
  • Population: 200,000
  • Shopping malls, apartments, hotels
  • Subway system connecting to other areas

During The Collapse:

Week 1: Panic, looting
Week 2: Crimson Flu hits hard
Week 3: Military quarantine fails
Week 4: Mass evacuation (partial success)
Month 2: Scavengers move in

Present Day:

  • Underground Network territory
  • Survivor communities (hostile/friendly)
  • Overgrown nature reclaiming the city
  • Subway = dangerous shortcut route

Military Outpost - “Firebase Delta” (Future Map)

Pre-Collapse:

  • Joint military research base
  • Weapons testing facility
  • Emergency command center
  • “Last stand” location

During The Collapse:

Day 1: Activated as emergency HQ
Day 7: Overrun by infected subjects
Day 14: Nuclear fail-safe considered
Day 21: Abandoned, automated defenses left active

Present Day:

  • Peacekeeper interest (reclaim mission)
  • Automated turrets still functional
  • Prototype weapon caches
  • Classified intel about The Collapse

🔮 Mysteries & Revelations

Core Mysteries (Unlocked via Gameplay)

Mystery 1: Who Caused The Collapse?

Hints scattered across:
- Audio logs (30% reveal)
- Quest chains (50% reveal)
- Environmental storytelling (20% reveal)

Answer: Combination of factors, but Nexus Corp's 
Project Prometheus was the primary catalyst.

Mystery 2: What is The Broker’s Identity?

In-game theories:
- Surviving Nexus executive
- AI that achieved consciousness
- Collective of information brokers
- Someone the player knows from the tutorial

Truth: [REDACTED - Season 3 reveal]

Mystery 3: Is There a Cure?

Quest hints:
- Dr. Chen's research (Tech Labs)
- Vaccine development data found in bunkers
- Underground medical experiments

Status: Possible, requires finding scattered research.

📖 Key Lore Documents (In-Game)

Audio Log Categories

Category Count Location Focus Theme
Worker Diaries 10 Industrial Daily life → collapse
Executive Memos 8 Offices Cover-up attempts
Military Orders 7 Various Chain of command break
Survivor Stories 12 All maps Personal tragedies
Nexus Research 8 Labs Project Prometheus
Faction Origins 5 Safe zones How factions formed

Sample Document: “Nexus Memo #7” 

FROM: Director Seo-Yun Park
TO: Project Prometheus Team
DATE: January 10, 2031
SUBJECT: Subject 7 Incident

The containment breach in Lab Alpha is now 
classified Level Black. Do NOT engage Subject 7 
directly. Enhanced capabilities exceed projections 
by 340%.

All research data is to be transferred to 
off-site backup immediately. If this facility 
is compromised, initiate Protocol PHOENIX.

Destroy this memo after reading.

[Handwritten note at bottom]:
"God forgive us for what we've done."

🗓️ Lore Reveal Roadmap

Season 1 (Launch)

  • The Collapse basics established
  • Introduction to 4 main factions
  • Hints about Project Prometheus
  • First audio logs (Industrial map)

Season 2

  • The Outbreak detailed explanation
  • Nexus Corporation history depth
  • Dr. Chen’s full story arc
  • Urban Ruins lore expansion

Season 3

  • Who caused The Collapse (full reveal)
  • The Broker identity hints
  • Military Outpost secrets
  • Player choices begin to impact lore events

Year 2+

  • Cure possibility explored
  • New external threats emerge
  • World expansion beyond Neo-Asia
  • Player-driven narrative events

🏴 Faction System Overview

Role of Factions

Factions are NOT playable sides. They function as:

  • Reputation System: Unlock rewards through loyalty

📋 Quest System Overview

Quest Categories

Category Duration Complexity Rewards
Main Story Multi-session High Major unlocks
Faction Quests 1-3 sessions Medium Reputation + Items
Daily Quests Single session Low Credits + XP
Weekly Quests Multi-session Medium Premium rewards
Challenge Quests Varies Very High Unique items

🎯 Main Story Quests

Chapter 1: “The Newcomer” (Tutorial Arc)

Quest 1.1: First Steps

Giver: System Tutorial
Objective: Complete extraction with any loot
Rewards: 500 Credits, Basic Loadout
Duration: 1 match

Quest 1.2: Meet the Factions

Giver: Safe Zone NPC
Objective: Talk to all 4 faction representatives
Rewards: 250 Rep each faction, Map Intel
Duration: Safe zone only

Quest 1.3: Prove Your Worth

Giver: Viktor Koval (Salvage Corps)
Objective: Extract with 3 Industrial Materials
Rewards: 1000 Credits, Salvage Rep +500
Duration: 1-2 matches

Chapter 2: “Whispers of Collapse” (Lore Arc)

Quest 2.1: The First Clue

Giver: Dr. Huang (Tech Syndicate)
Objective: Retrieve Data Drive from Tech Labs
Map: Industrial Decay
Location: Lab Alpha, 3rd Floor
Enemies: 5-7 AI guards
Rewards: 2000 Credits, Tech Rep +750, Audio Log #1

Quest 2.2: Survivor’s Account

Giver: Madame X (Underground)
Objective: Find and extract the "Witness" (NPC rescue)
Map: Industrial Decay > Urban Ruins
Stakes: Witness carries key information
Rewards: 3000 Credits, Underground Rep +1000, Lore unlock

🏴 Faction Quest Templates

Salvage Corps Quest Types

Type A: Resource Gathering

Template: "Collect [X] of [Material Type]"
Difficulty: Easy-Medium
Time: 1-2 matches

Example: "Steel Shortage"
- Collect 10 Metal Scraps
- Bonus: Find High-Grade Steel (+500 Rep)
- Reward: 1500 Credits, Worker's Toolbox

Type B: Repair Missions

Template: "Repair/Activate [Object] at [Location]"
Difficulty: Medium
Time: 1 match

Example: "Power Restored"
- Reach Generator Room (Reactor F1)
- Repair Generator (30 second interaction)
- Extract successfully
- Reward: 2000 Credits, Reputation +800

Type C: Convoy Protection

Template: "Escort [NPC/Object] to [Extraction]"
Difficulty: Hard
Time: Full match

Example: "Supply Run"
- Meet supply cart at Loading Docks
- Escort to Gate 03 (NPC takes damage)
- Protect from 3 AI ambush waves
- Reward: 4000 Credits, Reputation +1200, Rare Item

Tech Syndicate Quest Types

Type A: Data Recovery

Template: "Retrieve [Data Object] from [Secure Location]"
Difficulty: Medium
Time: 1 match

Example: "Project Prometheus Files"
- Locate Server Room in Lab Beta
- Hack terminal (15 seconds, creates noise)
- Download complete, extract with drive
- Reward: 2000 Credits, Intel item, Rep +750

Type B: Hack Missions

Template: "Hack [System] without being detected"
Difficulty: Hard (stealth optional)
Time: 1 match

Example: "Blind Eyes"
- Disable 3 Security Cameras in Offices
- Remain undetected (bonus objective)
- Reward: 2500 Credits, Stealth bonus +500

Underground Network Quest Types

Type A: Delivery/Smuggling

Template: "Transport [Package] to [Dead Drop]"
Difficulty: Medium
Time: 1 match

Example: "Hot Goods"
- Pick up package at Warehouse W2 (marked)
- Deliver to Dead Drop in Sewers
- Avoid Peacekeepers patrol (optional)
- Reward: 3000 Credits, Black Market access

Type B: Elimination

Template: "Eliminate [Target] in [Zone]"
Difficulty: Hard
Time: 1 match

Example: "No Witnesses"
- Kill named AI target "The Informant"
- Location: Office Complex, Floor 4
- Target has bodyguards (3 AI)
- Bonus: Retrieve documents from body
- Reward: 5000 Credits, Rep +1500

Peacekeepers Quest Types

Type A: Zone Clearing

Template: "Eliminate [X] hostiles in [Zone]"
Difficulty: Medium
Time: 1 match

Example: "Clean Sweep"
- Kill 15 Scav AI in Warehouse District
- Bonus: No civilian casualties
- Reward: 2000 Credits, Ammo crate

Type B: Rescue Operations

Template: "Rescue [Survivor] from [Danger]"
Difficulty: Hard (timed)
Time: 1 match, time limit

Example: "Trapped"
- Locate survivor in collapsed building
- Clear 5 enemies guarding area
- Escort survivor to Convoy extraction
- Time limit: 8 minutes
- Reward: 4000 Credits, Medical supplies, Rep +1200

item.title: Story & Narrative Design
item.description:
Story & Narrative Design

← Back to Index | Next: Characters →

📖 Narrative Philosophy

Storytelling Approach: Environmental & Emergent

Our game tells its story through:

  • Environmental storytelling - The world itself reveals what happened
  • Faction lore - Quest givers provide context and motivation
  • Emergent narratives - Player experiences create personal stories
  • Minimal cutscenes - Respect mobile session time

NOT:

  • Long cutscenes interrupting gameplay
  • Heavy dialogue trees
  • Linear story progression

🌍 World Lore

The Collapse (Year Zero)

What Happened:

In 2031, a catastrophic event known as “The Collapse” struck the world. A combination of:

  • Global economic meltdown
  • Simultaneous infrastructure cyberattacks
  • Weaponized pandemic outbreak
  • Resource wars escalation

Within 18 months, 60% of the world’s governments had fallen. Cities became lawless. Corporations retreated to fortified compounds. The military fractured into warlord factions.

The Exclusion Zones (Year 3-5)

What They Are:

As the chaos settled, certain areas became too dangerous or valuable to ignore:

  • Contaminated zones - Areas affected by chemical/biological agents
  • Resource hotspots - Abandoned industrial complexes with valuable materials
  • Failed military zones - Bases with prototype weapons and supplies
  • Corporate ruins - Tech companies with salvageable data and equipment

These became known as “Exclusion Zones” - officially off-limits, but ripe for exploitation.

The Extraction Economy (Year 5+)

The New Order:

A black market economy emerged around the Exclusion Zones:

  • Contractors (like our Operators) venture into zones
  • Extract valuable items (weapons, tech, data, resources)
  • Sell to Factions who control the outside world
  • Risk everything - death means losing your gear

This is the world players enter.

🗺️ Setting: Neo-Asia Exclusion Zone

Location

The game takes place in a fictional region called the Neo-Asia Industrial Corridor - a massive area spanning what was once a thriving manufacturing hub.

Inspired by:

  • Abandoned Chinese ghost cities
  • Korean DMZ aesthetic
  • Japanese industrial zones
  • Southeast Asian urban sprawl

Zone Characteristics

Industrial Decay (Map 1)

Former: Massive manufacturing complex
Now: Rusted factories, collapsed warehouses
Hazards: Unstable structures, chemical leaks
Loot: Industrial materials, old-world tech, weapons caches
Atmosphere: Silent except for creaking metal, dripping water

Urban Ruins (Map 2)

Former: Commercial district, residential high-rises
Now: Overgrown streets, looted apartments
Hazards: Hostile scavengers, structural collapse
Loot: Consumer electronics, medical supplies, personal valuables
Atmosphere: Eerie quiet, occasional distant gunfire

Military Outpost (Map 3 - Future)

Former: Joint military base, weapons depot
Now: Contested territory, partially active defenses
Hazards: Automated turrets, minefields, elite AI
Loot: Military-grade weapons, armor, classified data
Atmosphere: Tense, organized chaos

🏴 Factions

Factions are NOT playable. They serve as:

  • Quest givers
  • Lore sources
  • Vendors for unique rewards
  • Reputation systems

1. Salvage Corps

Identity:

Motto: "Honest Work in Lawless Lands"

📝 Environmental Storytelling Guidelines

How to Tell Story Without Words

Props & Set Dressing:

  • Skeleton poses tell a story (embracing, fighting, fleeing)
  • Graffiti hints at timeline (“Day 47 - no help coming”)
  • Personal items suggest past lives (children’s drawings, wedding photos)
  • Makeshift barricades show desperate last stands

Audio Logs (Rare Collectibles):

  • 30-60 second recordings
  • First-person accounts of The Collapse
  • Faction perspectives
  • Survivor stories
  • Total: 50 logs across all maps

Visual Contrasts:

  • Nature reclaiming urban spaces (hope)
  • Burned buildings next to pristine areas (randomness)
  • Child toys near violence (tragedy)
  • Corporate logos in ruins (irony)

🎭 Dialogue Guidelines

Voice Line Categories

Combat Callouts (Gameplay Priority):

  • Short, clear, no ambiguity
  • Examples: “Enemy spotted!”, “Reloading!”, “Grenade out!”

Character Moments (Flavor):

  • Show personality without disrupting gameplay
  • Examples: “This place gives me the creeps…”, “Almost reminds me of home.”

Faction Interactions (Quest NPCs):

  • Brief, purposeful
  • Always end with clear next step
  • Example structure:
    1. Greeting (2-3 sentences)
    2. Quest explanation (3-4 sentences)
    3. Reward mention (1 sentence)
    4. Send-off (1 sentence)

Writing Style

DO:

  • Keep it short
  • Use active voice
  • Show, don’t tell emotions
  • Include tactical information when relevant

DON’T:

  • Long monologues
  • Exposition dumps
  • Breaking immersion with meta-references
  • Offensive stereotypes
